The '''Banir Regional Energy Complex''', also known as the '''Dantooine Power Station''', was a building on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in [[3627 BBY]], which produced energy to nearby settlements.<ref name="CX">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Banir Regional Energy Complex}}</ref>

==Description==
The advanced facility combined wind and hydroelectric making it capable of producing enormous amounts of power needed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] industrialized farming initiative.<ref name="CX" />

==History==
Following the [[War against Zakuul|defeat]] of the [[Eternal Empire]], the Galactic Republic renewed their interest on the [[Dantooine]], leading to heavy investment in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] old infrastructure. The crumbling dam near [[Tokare Garrison]] was modified by Republic [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] into a high-tech energy complex.<ref name="CX" />

Despite the Republic's interest bringing benefits to the planet's residents&mdash;such as improved defenses and structures, and a renewed economy&mdash;some old guard Dantooinians decried the rapid development and warned their fellow citizens against relying on the Republic's assistance.<ref name="CX" />

During the [[Dantooine Incursion]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Yarvok]] of the [[Nova Blades]] took over the station and requested a ransom of 15 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for its [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]].<ref name="RR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Banir Regional Energy Complex is featured in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' update "The Dantooine Incursion". In-game the complex is named the Dantooine Power Station but its codex entry identifies it as the Banir Regional Energy Complex.<ref name="CX" />
